content: {"like":["Enjoys classic, family-friendly films that blend humor with heartfelt storytelling.","Values fresh, spontaneous acting styles and modern takes on traditional genres.","Appreciates well-curated collections and high-quality Blu-ray releases with crisp picture and sound.","Loves movies that combine sweet, light-hearted moments with clever, charming writing.","Prefers content that balances nostalgia with contemporary appeal, especially in holiday or themed marathons."],"dislike":["Dislikes technical issues with Blu-ray special features, such as non-functional menus or playback problems.","Dislikes when a film's character portrayal feels off or awkward, especially with iconic roles.","Dislikes childish or low-quality sequels that don't live up to the original's standard.","Dislikes being forced to leave a movie due to a poor experience, such as walking out of a film.","Dislikes content that lacks authenticity or depth, such as overemphasis on insecurities or lack of genuine performance."]}
